actions.visual-checker: Take screenshots of the page at phone, tablet and desktop width and look for layout problems
actions.react-reviewer: Review React component code: props, hooks, state and file structure
actions.css-reviewer: Review CSS: design tokens instead of raw values, responsive media queries

actions.contract-checker: Check that frontend types and backend API responses match
actions.done: Nothing left to check for this step; move on to the next plan step
